SELECT $__timeInterval(event_time) AS time, count() * 60 / $__interval_s AS queries
FROM system.query_log
WHERE $__dateTimeFilter(event_date, event_time) AND user = 'api' AND type != 'QueryStart'
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeInterval(event_time) AS time, countIf(type != 'QueryFinish') * 60 / $__interval_s AS errors
FROM system.query_log
WHERE $__dateTimeFilter(event_date, event_time) AND user = 'api' AND type != 'QueryStart'
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeInterval(event_time) AS time, quantile(0.5)(query_duration_ms) AS p50, quantile(0.95)(query_duration_ms) AS p95, quantile(0.99)(query_duration_ms) AS p99
FROM system.query_log
WHERE $__dateTimeFilter(event_date, event_time) AND user = 'api' AND type = 'QueryFinish'
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeInterval(event_time) AS time, sum(read_rows) AS rows_read, sum(read_bytes) AS bytes_read
FROM system.query_log
WHERE $__dateTimeFilter(event_date, event_time) AND user = 'api' AND type != 'QueryStart'
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT any(normalizeQuery(query)) AS query, count() AS calls, round(quantile(0.5)(query_duration_ms)) AS p50_ms, round(quantile(0.95)(query_duration_ms)) AS p95_ms, max(query_duration_ms) AS max_ms, round(avg(read_rows)) AS avg_rows_read
FROM system.query_log
WHERE $__dateTimeFilter(event_date, event_time) AND user = 'api' AND type = 'QueryFinish'
GROUP BY normalized_query_hash
ORDER BY p95_ms DESC, calls DESC
LIMIT 10
